title: The Cultural Gene of Large Language Models: A Study on the Impact of Cross-Corpus Training on Model Values and Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using a novel Cultural Probe Dataset (CPD) that consists of Value-Dilemma Probes (forced-choice ethical/social dilemmas), Scenario-Judgment Probes (evaluating the appropriateness of actions in social scenarios), and Stereotype-Association Probes (sentence-completion tasks). This dataset measures model alignment with Hofstede's cultural dimensions, specifically Individualism vs. Collectivism (IDV) and Power Distance Index (PDI).
